note: The OLG adequately covers the FNS requirement that ABAWDs must report when work hours fall below 20 per week. Two OLG sections directly address this: (1) 'ABAWD Work Rules Participation > Reporting Requirements for Clients Who Meet by Working' states 'non-exempt clients who meet the ABAWD Work Rules by working must report if their hours drop below 20 per week,' and (2) 'Simplified Reporting - Reporting Requirements During Case Maintenance > Subject to ABAWD Work Rules and Work Hours Fall Below 20 Per Week' repeats the same rule with examples. The OLG also specifies the 20-hour threshold is 'averaged monthly (or 80 hours per month),' matching FNS's 'averaged monthly' language. The OLG frames the reporting obligation under Simplified Reporting rules rather than stating it applies 'regardless of reporting system' as FNS does, but this is functionally aligned because BEACON assigns ABAWDs to Simplified Reporting by default (as shown in OLG's Certification Type Overview scenarios).
